table csv: The paper doesn't contain a CSV table specifically for the synthesis recipe, but the synthesis information is detailed in section 2.1 Synthesis.
extracted text: SU-21, [(Ge5.17Si1.83)O12(OH)2F2(NH2CH2CHNH2CH3)2]·H2O was prepared under hydro-/solvo-thermal conditions in the presence of 1,2-diaminopropane (DAP, 99%, Sigma-Aldrich). A typical synthesis procedure was: GeO2 (0.13g, 99.998%, Sigma-Aldrich) was added to a solution formed by a mixture of H2O (2.0ml), pyridine (Py, 10.0ml, 99.9%, Sigma-Aldrich) and 1,2-diaminopropane (3.0ml) under continuous stirring. Then tetraethyl orthosilicate (Si(OC2H5)4, 0.25ml, 99.999%, Sigma-Aldrich) was dropped slowly into the solution and a gel was formed. Finally, hydrofluoric acid (HF, 0.2ml, 40wt%, Fluka) was added to the gel. All reagents were used without further purifications. The molar ratio of the batch compositions was GeO2:Si(OC2H5)4:DAP:Py:H2O:HF = 1.0:0.9:28.4:99.7:95.0:3.6. The final mixture (pH = 10) was sealed in a 33ml Teflon-lined autoclave and heated at 175°C for 10 days under autogenous pressure.
